title: Meta's Muse Wonder: 3 Things to Know About Its New AI
description:
Meta just released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier-class AI models, built for AI agents.
Here are 3 things to know: two models, built for agents, and paid plans only. Meta says it rivals ChatGPT and Claude at coding, but outside testers haven't confirmed that yet.
